get.description: Without widget, returns widgets, generated_at and period (from, to, time_zone). Task creation/completion totals cover the account calendar week from local Monday through generated_at, excluding cancelled tasks. Trend compares against the previous complete Monday–Sunday week; completed_today uses the account time zone. Habits include total active habits. Calendar counts today and the next seven days, deduplicated by shared UID and occurrence start; previews include up to three events. Habits expose daily scheduled done/expected today, pending_today names and complete (all active habits have a recognized model), plus this calendar week to date. Weekly habits are not daily obligations. Load includes total_active, including subtasks. Focus exposes today/week seconds, active session and null goal_seconds (no goal in schema). Tags count unique active tasks per tag and current linked task creation/completion over 90 days; recent_activity is true or null (history unavailable), and assignment history is unavailable. Integration booleans reflect the authenticated account connection, not only server configuration. Includes overdue_by_list with disjoint calendar-age buckets under_7, days_7_30 and over_30, based on the same canonical overdue set as the count. Habits, calendar and next_countdowns expose configured independently of current activity. Projects exclude the inbox and include open/closed lists plus all accessible soft deletions, seven-day task activity and review signals (no pending tasks or no task changes for 30 days), excluding note lists and closed projects from suggestions.
